releases.name: The Great Sassanelli - An Interactive Novel
Amnea28: two eternities
releases.summary:
"Amnea 28" is a visual novel about a group of young people who go to listen to a course of lectures by a respected professor of psychology. Their destination is "Amnea", an old hotel which ceased to fulfill its main functions ten years ago and now serves as the professor's residence. Week of studying didn't promise any problems, yet the atmosphere felt more unsettling with each passing day. 

Why did the students' behavior suddenly become strange? What are they hiding? The protagonist will have to solve all the mysteries of "Amnea", otherwise the walls of the old hotel won't let her leave alive.

releases.name: Night Cart: The Immortal Plague
releases.summary: A first-person gothic adventure where you drive a horse-drawn cart through plague-ridden Transylvania alongside an immortal woman, exploring forgotten places, battling desperate foes, uncovering ancient secrets, and searching for the legendary Count Saint Germain.

releases.name: The Big Suck
releases.summary: A short incremental game where you are the disaster. Destroy fields, cars, buildings. Gather wreck to grow and spend it on upgrades inside the big skill tree.

releases.name: Neon One-Man Army
releases.summary: High-speed, neon-infused single-player action! Swing through platforms with your grappling gun, blast rogue robots, and stay airborne to survive. Choose powerful cards at every level, unlock skill chests, and master the ultimate momentum-based power fantasy.

releases.name: Farmstead Market Simulator
releases.summary: Build and grow your own farm and roadside market. Grow crops, raise animals, craft valuable products, set prices, hire employees, stock your shelves, serve customers, and expand your small operation into a thriving business.

releases.name: Plum
releases.summary: Plum is a 3d cozy platforming and collectathon game where you will have to roll and bounce through the valley in search for home. On your way, meet different ghost plums each which a story to share. This game is a colorful stylized short adventure (about 1h) made to chill or speedrunning.

releases.name: Hotdog Killer
releases.summary: Fun Foxy Top Gear Challenge - Free Street Surfing Endurance Race is an exciting fast pasted game. Remember Street Surfing in the Michael J. Fox movie Teen Wolf? Control Fun Foxy the Fox as he Street Surfs on a variety of crazy cars like the Delorean from Back to the Future, The Flintstones car, and the Ghostbusters Ambulance. Turbocharge Foxy in a rallycross style race to the north.

releases.name: HO HO HO SOKOBAN
releases.summary: A cozy Christmas-themed Sokoban puzzle game where Santa must push presents into the right places. Solve 50 handcrafted pixel art levels full of festive charm.

releases.name: TORAWASE: The Girl in the Mirror
The Inspector
releases.summary: a Train has been infected with mysterious anomalies. G.O.A.B has secretly hired you to inspect the train. It's your job to find the anomalies and terminate them.

releases.name: Tube2K
releases.summary: Build the video sharing platform that will change the world. Will you bring about the Golden Age of humanity or bring it to its knees?

releases.name: Go Next!
releases.summary: Grow exponentially stronger as you survive hordes of monsters across 9 different worlds. Gather resources, level up, build your skill tree, and parkour your way out of chaos!

releases.name: Wild Hive
releases.summary: Wild Hive is a bee colony sim driven by a ruthless honey market. Hatch workers, brew honey, and sell it well — because the quota climbs every year, and the year you miss it, your run is over. Build Your HiveLay brood cells for your queen, raise honey silos, and shape the hex grid your colony lives in. Every silo type pushes the hive's temperature, humidity, and CO₂ — your floor plan is your climate control. Build it right and brew four varieties of honey; build it wrong and cook your own bees. Forage or StarveSend workers on nectar runs, from the safety of Bluebell Woods to the rich, risky Alpine Meadows — every trip a bet on yield against the odds of coming home. Fields deplete as you strip them and refill with the seasons, so rotate your crews or fly home empty. Upgrade a favorite field for bigger stockpiles, faster flights, or a shot at Super Nectar. Play the MarketHoney has one price, and it never sits still. Ride the booms, dodge the crashes, and sell at the peak to clear the year's quota before winter runs out. Work the RAX exchange on the side — buy shares in five rival hives, pocket the dividends, and lease out idle bees for a steady cut. Survive the SeasonsYour hive breathes: temperature, humidity, and CO₂ drift with the weather and your own architecture. Let one cross the red line and bees die, honey spoils, silos crumble. When winter freezes your nectar solid, thaw it fast — or lose it. Defend the QueenWasps raid the hive. Workers drop everything and charge; you hire mercenary bees to hold the line. When the last defender falls, the wasps go for the Queen — and if she dies, so does the colony.  Hatch, feed, and put to work a swarm of autonomous bees — every one of them mortal. Grow honey silos through 9 levels and 4 types to brew 4 varieties of honey. Pin up to 3 Royal Seals a year — permanent modifiers that bend the rules of your run. Trade shares in 5 rival hives and lease out your workforce on the RAX exchange. Settle 5 biomes, from fishing the Mountain Lake to catching apples in the Juicy Orchards. Outplay a rival queen at Honeycomb Clash, or ferment your surplus into mead at the Meadery. Reach level 30, then climb 7 tiers of Wax difficulty that rewrite the rules against you. Or ignore the quota entirely in Endless mode and grow the biggest hive you can.Your first colony will collapse. Your empire starts with the next one.

releases.name: Idle Camp Tale
releases.summary: Camp & Conquer is a fantasy idle RPG. Manage your camp, recruit heroes, and let auto-battles fight for you. Farm gear and materials from every fight, then strengthen, enchant, and customize affixes to forge your own powerful equipment as you conquer the frontier stage by stage!

releases.name: Vida:Unslain
releases.summary: Vida: Unslain is a dungeon exploration game where players explore labyrinths, battle enemies, choose their path, and progress through each dungeon.

releases.name: Palisade
releases.summary: Draw borders, build roads and strongholds, and conquer rival realms in a fast single-player strategy game fought across sixteen historically grounded scenarios. Command five campaigns, custom Skirmishes, and a shared Daily Chronicle.

releases.name: What the Buck?!
releases.summary: What the Buck?! is an incremental game about destroying money. Smash stacks of cash, upgrade your destructive power, automate your money withdrawals, declare bankruptcy and watch the numbers explode.

releases.name: Menthal
releases.summary: Menthal is a first-person horror game where you are the test subject. Take experimental medicine, endure the side effects, and try to survive what happens next.

releases.name: Game Launch Simulator
releases.summary: GameLaunchSimulator is a text-based management sim about the full journey of publishing an indie game. Build your studio, plan new projects, prepare store pages, grow wishlists, handle reviews, release windows, publishing deals, and post-launch operations, then bring an unknown game to real players.

releases.name: Mini Mart Survivors
releases.summary: SHIFT24 is no ordinary convenience store chain. Strange customers swarm in endlessly, and ramen, snacks, coffee, anything on the shelf is a weapon. Fend them off, chase the clues worldwide, and pay your debt to uncover SHIFT24's truth.

releases.name: Eye of Darkness
releases.summary:
Eye of Darkness is a survivor rogue-lite game with a focus on exploration in which you take on the role of a cultist trying to summon the Eye of Darkness.

The forces of Light and Darkness have been locked in an eternal struggle for ultimate power. For eons, the Light has suppressed the Darkness, imprisoning the Eye of Darkness to maintain its dominance. Under the Light’s rule, humanity lives under strict laws and rigid hierarchies, to suppress heresy.

But now, a cult devoted to the Darkness sees an opportunity...

releases.name: Kimbap Heaven Simulator
releases.summary: Run your own Korean restaurant in Kimbap Heaven Simulator. Dive into a realistic cooking experience—wash, blanch, and roll your way to success. Satisfy customers with delicious recipes, manage your finances, and expand your business to build a culinary empire.
